responses.evidence: The B-05 test-plan scenario now covers all four scoped roles and asserts exact prompt bytes, ordered artifact classes and stable IDs, omitted classes, manifest version, and exact presence or absence of each named token count.

The B-06 test-plan scenario now uses two slices with token counts present on only some invocations, requires exact slice/run totals, and requires unavailable token names to be absent rather than synthesized at both levels.

A P-02 test-plan scenario now supplies ordered and forbidden historical-context markers to applicable initial and revision/repair inputs and asserts role order plus absence of prior conversations, other-role conversations, resolved findings, and passing raw logs.

A P-05 test-plan scenario now runs src/kiro.test.ts, src/claude.test.ts, and src/codex.test.ts and asserts exact assembled-prompt delivery through Kiro argv and Claude/Codex stdin while preserving adapter-owned command flags.
